annotations.title: Trim junk out of text before pasting it into an AI chat

description: Shrinks a prompt, chat, log, stack trace, JSON dump or code paste so it uses fewer tokens: removes base64 and data blobs, minifies JSON, shortens stack traces, squashes repeated log lines, strips code comments and link tracking parameters, and collapses whitespace. Optionally drops pleasantries and markdown. Returns the trimmed text and how much was saved. Token numbers here are rough estimates (about 4 characters per token); the website shows exact counts.

rules.description: Rules to apply. Default: blobs, json, traces, repeats, comments, urls, space. Also available: polite, markdown.

text.description: The text to trim (up to 200,000 characters).

name: tokendiet_trim_text
